info.name: Validate and verify a phone number.

params.name: api_key
params.description: Your Abstract API Phone Validation API key.

params.name: phone
params.description: The phone number to validate, ideally in E.164 format.

items.docs: Validates a single phone number and returns validity, local and international formats, country, registered location, line type, and carrier.

info.name: Validate a number with a country hint.

params.name: api_key
params.description: Your Abstract API Phone Validation API key.

params.name: phone
params.description: A phone number without an international dialing code.

params.name: country
params.description: Optional ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code used to interpret the number.

items.docs: Validates a number supplied without a country code, using the optional country parameter as a hint. The country parameter is modeled from Abstract API documentation.
